name: Acting
overview: Scripture calls believers to live authentically as followers of God, reflecting His character through their actions and thoughts. Acting in a manner consistent with godly virtues—such as truth, purity, and honesty—honors God's name and avoids association with darkness. Empowered by Christ’s strength, Christians are to reject unfruitful deeds and instead courageously reprove them, demonstrating a life transformed by faith and guided by love.
